verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client rather than primarily an agent, and it already exposes integration surfaces (WebDAV server, Shortcuts automation, Files access), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The built-in Repository Agent is an assistant inside the app and does not serve tools to external agents. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI also returned 404.
